literal: Greatness-yielding wealth even if obtaining, to others harmful things not doing is the blemishless people's principle.
translation: Even if one were to obtain wealth that yields great glory, refraining from doing harmful things to others is the firm principle of those who are stainless.
modern: சிறப்பைத் தரும் செல்வத்தைப் பெறுவதாக இருந்தாலும், மற்றவர்களுக்குத் துன்பம் செய்யாமல் இருப்பதே குற்றமற்றவர்களின் கொள்கையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the core principle of pure, faultless individuals. Even if they are offered immense wealth that brings supreme glory, they will not commit harmful deeds against others to acquire it. The word 'மாசற்றார்' refers to those free from the blemishes of the mind, and 'கோள்' represents their unshakeable vow or doctrine. Thus, harmlessness is placed above all worldly success and glory.
